title: phlomoides rotala
intro: Phlomoides rotala, commonly known as Rotula, is a flowering plant species within the Lamiaceae family. It is native to tropical Africa, particularly in the countries of Nigeria and Cameroon, where it grows in forests and grasslands. The health benefits of Phlomoides rotala include its ability to reduce fever and relieve respiratory issues, while its therapeutic actions include its use as an anti-inflammatory and antibacterial agent. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
